name: How much does it cost to have a kitchen faucet installed?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to have a kitchen faucet installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen faucet installation varies based on labor rates, the complexity of the installation, and any additional plumbing work required. It also depends on whether you provide the faucet or if it is supplied by the installer. For residents in our service areas like Alameda or Berkeley, a local quote from Hometelligent Inc. will provide an accurate cost after assessing the specific job details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen faucet installation costs vary by labor, complexity, and whether the faucet is provided by the customer or installer. Hometelligent Inc. provides local quotes in areas like Alameda and Berkeley.
